lines.t: Verse 1
I used to seek the favor of men,
Measuring my worth in their eyes.
Every compliment a fleeting breath,
Every silence another disguise.
I feared that You felt the same,
Seeing me the way they do.
But love kept rising through the dark,
And grace kept stirring up my heart.
Pre-Chorus
Now the weight begins to fall away,
And the truth breaks through the noise.
My heart learns how to rest again,
In the sound of Your voice.
Chorus
You are the river that won’t run dry,
The fire still burning when hope has died.
Love that bleeds through every wound I hide —
You are enough, You are enough for this life.
Verse 2
I can’t earn the breath You gave,
I can only fall into truth.
Your Word became the life I crave,
And it’s rewriting what I thought I knew.
I was made for this communion,
Heart to Heart, faith alive,
Where every fear drowns in mercy’s tide.
Pre-Chorus
Every breath is new beginning,
Every scar a place You’ve healed.
What once was fear is now belonging,
What once was lost is being revealed.
Chorus
You are the river that won’t run dry,
The flame that refines, the peace inside.
Love unbroken, unconditional, and kind —
You are enough, You are enough for this life.
Bridge
No shadow left, no distance wide,
No voice but Yours can quiet my mind.
I see Your heart in the morning sky,
And Your cross still shining in my night.
You are the river that won’t run dry!
You lift me beyond the reasons why!
The One who stays, the One who saves —
Forever enough, forever alive!
Forever enough…
The river runs through my soul.
Forever enough…
You are enough, You are enough.
